requests.reply: {"translations": ["In the early morning, the mist outside the mountain gate has not yet dispersed.", "Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough spirit stones?"]}
{"translations": ["Brought three bags, all from the best in the back mountain."]}
{"translations": ["The barrier cracked again last night, Elder Qin didn't sleep all night."]}
{"translations": ["Before his words fell, Wanqi Jing rushed up from the mountain.", "He panted and said, a young woman was lying on the roadside at the foot of the mountain"]}
{"translations": ["Quickly lift him up. Ruoshui, go get the healing pills."]}
{"translations": ["Wanqi Jing carried the unconscious woman into the main hall, the iron plaque at his waist was engraved with: Qiu (qiú) Shuang."]}
{"translations": ["The injury is not serious, it's just that the spiritual power is exhausted. Feed it a Spirit Recovery Pill."]}
{"translations": ["Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qin asked you to go to the barrier. I and Senior Brother Wanqi are here.", "Okay. Miss Qiu has woken up, come call me immediately."]}
{"translations": ["Wanqi Jing scratched his head, then turned and ran towards the foot of the mountain."]}
{"translations": ["Jie Xuan stood at the entrance of the hall, his sword unsheathed, but the lights flickered for a moment."]}
{"translations": ["Elder Qin, how have you been? I come under the orders of the Pavilion Master to collect thirty percent of the spirit stones."]}

{"translations": ["Three-tenths? Spirit stones are painstakingly saved by the sect, when is it outsiders' turn to take them?", "The barrier is cracked, it's not safe to keep the spirit stones in your hands. I'll come back in three days."]}
{"translations": ["Jie Xuan sneered, turned and left, without looking back."]}
{"translations": ["Say three days is three days, never break a promise."]}
{"translations": ["Elder Qin stroked his beard and looked at Qiu Shuang, who was sleeping on the couch."]}
{"translations": ["Elder, let me guard the barrier. Miss Qiu has Lechuan to look after, I can leave.", "Finally, he nodded and took out a jade talisman from his sleeve."]}
{"translations": ["This is the array's eye. Only by guarding it can you say you have guarded your path."]}
{"translations": ["Le Chuan tucked the medicine pouch into Yun Zhou's embrace and whispered a few more instructions."]}
{"translations": ["At the mountain gate, Wanqi Jing handed over a straw raincoat.", "Thank you, Senior Brother Wanqi. Miss Qiu has woken up, and she says thank you for me."]}
{"translations": ["Dan Yunzhou nodded and put the array eye token close to his body."]}
{"translations": ["In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes."]}
{"translations": ["It's good that you're awake. You were unconscious all day, don't move around ▼"]}
{"translations": ["Chou Shuang struggled to sit up, looking at the cracked sky outside the window.", "Unnoticed, the letter in her sleeve bore the seal of Jie Xuan."]}

translations.1: In the early morning, the mist outside the mountain gate has not yet dispersed.
translations.10: Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qin asked you to go to the barrier. I and Senior Brother Wanqi are here.
translations.11: Okay. Miss Qiu has woken up, come call me immediately.
translations.12: Wanqi Jing scratched his head, then turned and ran towards the foot of the mountain.
translations.13: Jie Xuan stood at the entrance of the hall, his sword unsheathed, but the lights flickered for a moment.
translations.14: Elder Qin, how have you been? I come under the orders of the Pavilion Master to collect thirty percent of the spirit stones.
translations.15: Three-tenths? Spirit stones are painstakingly saved by the sect, when is it outsiders' turn to take them?
translations.16: The barrier is cracked, it's not safe to keep the spirit stones in your hands. I'll come back in three days.
translations.17: Jie Xuan sneered, turned and left, without looking back.
translations.18: Say three days is three days, never break a promise.
translations.19: Elder Qin stroked his beard and looked at Qiu Shuang, who was sleeping on the couch.
translations.2: Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough spirit stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me guard the barrier. Miss Qiu has Lechuan to look after, I can leave.
translations.21: Finally, he nodded and took out a jade talisman from his sleeve.
translations.22: This is the array's eye. Only by guarding it can you say you have guarded your path.
translations.23: Le Chuan tucked the medicine pouch into Yun Zhou's embrace and whispered a few more instructions.
translations.24: At the mountain gate, Wanqi Jing handed over a straw raincoat.
translations.25: Thank you, Senior Brother Wanqi. Miss Qiu has woken up, and she says thank you for me.
translations.26: Dan Yunzhou nodded and put the array eye token close to his body.
translations.27: In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: It's good that you're awake. You were unconscious all day, don't move around ▼
translations.29: Chou Shuang struggled to sit up, looking at the cracked sky outside the window.
translations.3: Brought three bags, all from the best in the back mountain.
translations.30: Unnoticed, the letter in her sleeve bore the seal of Jie Xuan.
translations.4: The barrier cracked again last night, Elder Qin didn't sleep all night.
translations.5: Before his words fell, Wanqi Jing rushed up from the mountain.
translations.6: He panted and said, a young woman was lying on the roadside at the foot of the mountain
translations.7: Quickly lift him up. Ruoshui, go get the healing pills.
translations.8: Wanqi Jing carried the unconscious woman into the main hall, the iron plaque at his waist was engraved with: Qiu (qiú) Shuang.
translations.9: The injury is not serious, it's just that the spiritual power is exhausted. Feed it a Spirit Recovery Pill.
